description: This file defines a Java interface 'Scenario1Simple' that extends 'Scenario' and specifies a security policy and related methods for scenario testing within the project. It includes policy creation, scenario group identification, and application of a policy algorithm.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined policy object that encapsulates permissions and subjects for the scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group, derived from the class name.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that applies a given policy algorithm to check permissions on the resource setup.
